name: 尤正吉
objective:
先修課程：無

機構被用來傳遞運動和力量，在真實的世界裡隨處可見。常用的機構包括連桿、齒輪、凸輪、皮帶、鏈條、繩索、螺旋、和摩擦傳動機構，在 “機動學” 中我們將學習如何利用解析法與作圖法分析包括連桿、齒輪和凸輪之運動，並認識這些理論如何應用於 (軌道) 車輛機構上的分析。
schedule:
1.Introduction, Constraint Analysis
2.Four-Bar Linkages
3.Inversion, Motion Limits
4.Midterm(1),Analytical Linkage Analysis-Four-Bar Linkage
5.Analytical Linkage Analysis-Slider-Crank Mechanism
6.Analytical Linkage Analysis-Slider-Crank Inversion
7.Graphic Linkage Analysis
8.Instant Center of Velocity
9.Special Mechanisms, Midterm(2)
10.Railway application examples (bogies, pantographs, brakes), Midterm(3)
11.Spun Gear-1
12.Helical Gear
13.Bevel Gear
14. Midterm(4)
15.Simple and Compound Gear Train
16.Planetary Gear Train
17.Cam-Follower System
18.Midterm(5)
materials:
Textbook:
K. J. Waldron,G. L. Kinzel,  and S. K. Agrawal, "Kinematics, Dynamics, and Design of  Machinery", 3rd, John Wiley & Sons, Inc., 2016, pp. 1-58, 279-394, 431-578. (歐亞書局)
Reference:
Martin, G. H., Kinematics and Dynamics of Machines, McGraw-Hill Publishing Co., 1982.
